dependencies {
    implementation project(':TMessagesProj')
    implementation project(':InuCore')
    implementation files('../TMessagesProj/libs/libgsaverification-client.aar')
    implementation 'androidx.core:core:1.16.0'
    implementation 'androidx.fragment:fragment:1.8.5'
    implementation 'org.mvel:mvel2:2.5.2.Final'
    implementation 'com.linkedin.dexmaker:dexmaker:2.28.6'
    implementation 'org.lsposed.hiddenapibypass:hiddenapibypass:6.1'
    if (!rootProject.ext.inuPluginless) {
        implementation 'androidx.profileinstaller:profileinstaller:1.4.1'
        shadowhookAar 'com.bytedance.android:shadowhook:2.0.1'
    }

if (!(argument in ['PLUGINS', 'ANALYTICS'])) throw new GradleException("${source}:${index + 1}: expected #if PLUGINS or ANALYTICS")
                        def condition = argument == 'PLUGINS' ? !rootProject.ext.inuPluginless : inuAnalytics
                        stack.add([parent: active, condition: condition, alternate: false, line: index + 1])
                        active = active && condition
